name: WHAMR!
description: A reverberant, noisy speech separation dataset created by adding noise and reverberation to WSJ0 mixtures, with corresponding clean-source signals.
citation: Mack, W., and colleagues. (2020). WHAMR!: Noisy and Reverberant Single-Channel Speech Separation. IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP). https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.06762

license.notes: WHAMR! does not specify a standard SPDX license identifier. Review the dataset terms and the underlying WSJ0 source-data restrictions before use or redistribution.
